description: This file contains functions and data structures related to reading and manipulating Git tree objects, including traversal, comparison, and parsing tree data from the repository.

methods.name: int read_tree_at(struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,struct strbuf * base,int depth,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
methods.description: Recursively reads a tree object in the repository, processing each entry with a callback function, with depth control and handling submodules.

methods.name: int read_tree(struct repository * r,struct tree * tree,const struct pathspec * pathspec,read_tree_fn_t fn,void * context)
methods.description: Initializes and calls read_tree_at to start reading from the top-level tree.

methods.name: int base_name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)
methods.description: Compares two base names (paths) considering directory vs file distinction.

methods.name: int df_name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,int mode1,const char * name2,size_t len2,int mode2)
methods.description: Compares names with special handling for directory/file conflicts.

methods.name: int name_compare(const char * name1,size_t len1,const char * name2,size_t len2)
struct:tree * lookup_tree(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Looks up or creates a tree object in the repository based on object id.

methods.name: int parse_tree_buffer(struct tree * item,void * buffer,unsigned long size)
methods.description: Parses a tree object buffer into a tree structure.

methods.name: int repo_parse_tree_gently(struct repository * r,struct tree * item,int quiet_on_missing)
methods.description: Parses a tree object from the repository, with error handling for missing objects.

methods.name: void free_tree_buffer(struct tree * tree)
methods.description: Frees resources associated with a tree's buffer.

methods.name: struct:tree * repo_parse_tree_indirect(struct repository * r,const struct object_id * oid)
methods.description: Parses a tree object indirectly from an object id.
